children.name: Intro
children.content: Canvas is a design canvas you share with AI agents. Agents draw here while you watch, and you point at things to talk about them.

children.name: This file is a short course: eleven less
children.content: This file is a short course: eleven lessons, one board each. Every board says what to press and has something to try it on.

children.content: Using Claude Code or Codex? Press Connect on the card to the left. Lesson 2 shows the rest.

children.name: Canvas is in alpha. When something feels
children.content: Canvas is in alpha. When something feels wrong, slow or confusing, report it on GitHub (Issues). Every report makes the first real version come sooner.
